scope: Full XTEA algorithm article only; no completion claim for TEA, Block TEA, XXTEA, DES, AES, RC5 or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 XTEA 这一种 64 位 ARX 分组密码：128 位密钥、按 sum 位选字的密钥调度、32 个推荐循环（64 次字更新，通常称为 64 轮）、参考向量、64 位块边界，以及它与 TEA、Block TEA、XXTEA 的区别；不把 TEA、XXTEA、DES、AES 或工作模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the XTEA 64-bit ARX block cipher: 128-bit key, sum-bit key selection, the recommended 32 cycles (64 word updates, commonly called 64 rounds), reference vectors, the 64-bit block bound and the distinction from TEA, Block TEA and XXTEA. It does not absorb TEA, XXTEA, DES, AES or a mode of operation.
